name: FND_COLUMN_DATASHAPES
description: This table will be used to maintain the Column level Datashape Info for all Fusion Tables and Columns. It will store the current Datashape Info (Actual) which will be automatically populated by a script and also the Target Datashape Info to be populated by the Table Owners based on their requirements. The goal is to match both Target and Actual values.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: ENTERPRISE_ID

columns.name: TABLE_ID
columns.description: This value comes from FND_TABLES

columns.name: COLUMN_ID
columns.description: This value comes from FND_COLUMNS

columns.name: COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: This value comes from FND_COLUMNS

columns.name: COLUMN_TYPE
columns.description: User provided, could me 'LOV', 'FK', 'PK' or anything else

columns.name: PERCENT_NULLS
columns.description: Percentage values that are NULL

columns.name: MIN_DISTRIBUTION_TARGET
columns.description: Minimum # of Duplicates that should eventually be in the DB

columns.name: MIN_DISTRIBUTION_ACTUAL
columns.description: Minimum # of Duplicates that are currently there in the DB

columns.name: MAX_DISTRIBUTION_TARGET
columns.description: Maximum # of Duplicates that should eventually be in the DB

columns.name: MAX_DISTRIBUTION_ACTUAL
columns.description: Maximum # of Duplicates that are currently there in the DB

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_CURVE_TARGET
columns.description: Distribution Curve Type that should eventually be in the DB (Progressive, Regressive, Even, Bell-Shaped)

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_CURVE_ACTUAL
columns.description: Distribution Curve Type currently in the DB (Progressive, Regressive, Even, Bell-Shaped)

columns.name: LOV_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Table Name that contains the LOV Values (i.e FND_LOOKUPS)

columns.name: LOV_LOOKUP_TYPE
columns.description: Lookup Type specified for this LOV in the LOV Table (i.e Opty Type)

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: LOV_VALUES_TARGET
columns.description: Target LOV Values

columns.name: LOV_VALUES_ACTUAL
columns.description: Actual LOV Values currently in the DB

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_DATASHAPE_INFO
columns.description: Any Additional Datashape Information
